conviction_note: No consensus exists and nothing decisive turned up. The lean comes from two primary documents: the July operating report and a board-represented holder buying after quarter-end. Both are small, so p_up is 52 and the scaled number is (2*0.52-1)*10 = +0.4. The findings sum to +0.7. The two measurements agree in sign and both are small. abs_move_pct is 10 rather than 15, because the filing hour is unknown: the 2026 10-Qs went in at 08:34 ET (May 15) and 14:25 ET (Aug 4), the Q3 2025 one at 16:18 ET. A filing after 16:00 ET on Nov 16 would leave the reaction outside this window, and an intraday one would put only part of it inside.
bar: Unsourced, so every finding is capped small. No analyst covers QVCG: stockanalysis.com lists no coverage (https://stockanalysis.com/stocks/qvcg/), Benzinga has no consensus, and the company gives no guidance (Q2 10-Q). The implicit bar is trend extrapolation from Q3 2025: revenue $2.21bn and Adjusted OIBDA $169m (https://investors.qvcgrp.com/news-media/press-releases/detail/662/qvc-group-reports-third-quarter-2025-financial-results). Run at the H1 2026 trend (revenue -9% to -11%, Adjusted OIBDA -29% to -32%; https://quartr.com/events/qvc-group-inc-qvcga-q2-2026_3elIrDBt), that gives about $1.97-2.01bn revenue and about $115-120m Adjusted OIBDA. Session: the company release of 2026-11-09 says the 10-Q will be filed 'Monday, November 16th, 2026' with an audio recording posted alongside, and gives no hour (https://investors.qvcgrp.com/news/press-releases/detail/670). EDGAR acceptance times for this CIK: 2026-05-15 12:34 UTC (08:34 ET, filed on its deadline day), 2026-08-04 18:25 UTC (14:25 ET), 2025-11-05 21:18 UTC (16:18 ET) (https://data.sec.gov/submissions/CIK0001254699.json). Nov 16 is the 10-Q deadline. So bmo is plausible but not settled; it could equally be intraday or after the close.
positioning_check: Short interest is 425k shares, about 0.8% of shares outstanding and 2.5 days to cover (FINRA settlement 2026-10-30, via https://equibles.com/stocks/qvcg/shortinterest, per the sweep). That is roughly 3.5% of the float: four holders own about 75% of the 50.0m shares (SVP 26.2%, Silver Point 17.3% at listing, GoldenTree 15.7%, Oaktree 14.4%; 424B3 https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1254699/000110465926112834/tm2625133-3_424b3.htm), so the float is about 12m shares. The short is not crowded. There is no options market and no skew. Tape: spot 8.185; down 58% from the 52-week high of about $20 at the August listing, and up 18.6% from the low of about $6.80-6.90. Run-up 20d -11.8%, 5d +8.55%, and +5% on 2026-11-13 itself. The stock fell about 41% in October with no company news (AAII, https://www.aaii.com/investingideas/article/554312-why-qvc-group-inc8217s-qvcg-stock-is-down-595). Supply: a resale shelf for 37.6m shares (75% of shares) went effective 2026-09-29. Silver Point sold 720k shares at $16.45 on 09-03 and 1.352m at $12.35 on 10-09, leaving 4.95m shares (9.9%). Below 10% its further sales no longer need a Form 4. Average volume is about 199k shares a day, about $1.6m.

findings.finding: QVC, Inc.'s own July 2026 operating report, the first month of Q3, shows net sales of $295.8m against $313.8m in June (-5.7% month on month). Gross margin rose to 36.4% from 33.8%: gross profit was $107.8m against $106.0m on lower sales. G&A fell to $58.0m from $67.8m. Net loss was -$42.3m, of which $37.7m was reorganization items. The report is unaudited, covers one legal entity (about three quarters of QxH's monthly run-rate), and has no prior-year comparison.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: None usable. This is the first print as post-reorganization equity, and the baseline history belongs to the predecessor entity (sweep: baseline_history_trustworthy false).
findings.why_not_priced: It was furnished as an image-based bankruptcy exhibit under a Reg FD 8-K carrying a 'do not rely' legend, and no analyst covers the stock. If the market had read a margin uptick in July, the October slide to $6.80 would have needed a fundamental cause, and none was published. The June comparator sits in a separate 8-K exhibit (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1254699/000110465926089810/tm2621892d1_ex99-1.htm).
findings.independence: June MOR (separate document, same reporting format): https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1254699/000110465926089810/tm2621892d1_ex99-1.htm. Nothing independent points the same way for Aug-Sep.

findings.finding: GoldenTree has a board designee and is a 13D filer. It bought 1,687,779 shares between 2026-09-24 and 2026-10-09 at an average of about $12.67, for about $21.4m, raising its stake to 12.68m shares (25.4%). That includes 1.352m shares at $12.35 on 10-09, nine days after Q3 closed. The 10-09 block's seller was Silver Point, also board-represented, which had sold 720k shares at $16.45 on 09-03. Spot is now $8.19, about 35% below GoldenTree's average cost.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: None. No prior prints as this equity.
findings.why_not_priced: The buying stopped at $12.35. Since then the stock has fallen 34% to $8.19 with no further GoldenTree Form 4, so the market has traded through the holder's cost rather than anchoring on it. If a better-informed holder's post-quarter purchase had been taken as a floor, the stock would not have printed $6.80 within two weeks. The caveat is already netted in: an informed seller (Silver Point) sat on the other side of the same block, and GoldenTree did not add below $12.
findings.independence: GoldenTree Form 4 (P, 1,352,000 at $12.35, 10-09): https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1254699/000149315226047051/xslF345X06/ownership.xml. Silver Point Form 4 (S, same block, the opposite reading): https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1254699/000119312526421839/xslF345X06/ownership.xml. All three filings describe one transaction cluster.

findings.finding: The 10-Q will be the first fresh-start balance sheet and will show the Sep 30 cash and ABL draw. At emergence the plan reserved minimum cash of $325-350m, and takeback debt is $1.325bn at 10% (about $132m a year of interest). The confirmed plan's net EV was $1.6-1.9bn (Octus). Today's market EV is about $1.4bn: $407m equity plus $1.325bn debt less about $325m cash.
findings.why_not_priced: Sep 30 liquidity has not been disclosed anywhere. The PCR for Aug 6-Sep 30 carries $0 on every line (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1254699/000125469926000028/qvcgrouppcrdocketno1052.htm). Q3 is the inventory build for holiday. An ABL draw would read as distress, and comfortable cash would read as the reverse, so the sign is genuinely open. The EV discount to the plan range is the public 'it is cheap' read and carries almost no weight here.
findings.independence: Plan EV range: https://octus.com/resources/articles/judge-perez-confirms-qvcs-prepackaged-plan/ (2026-07-15). Cash-reserve terms in the plan: https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/0001355096/000110465926086686/tm2621254d1_ex2-1.htm

findings.finding: The trend into the print is negative and public. In the Q2 2026 10-Q, QxH revenue fell 12.5% on lower units with ASP down 2.3%. QxH Adjusted OIBDA fell to $99m from $150m. International revenue fell 4.9% in constant currency. Advertising rose 10.3% on social and streaming spend. Group Adjusted OIBDA fell 28.8% in Q1 and 31.5% in Q2.
findings.why_not_priced: Mostly priced: the stock is down 58% from listing. The residual is that Q3 2025 (Adjusted OIBDA $169m, already -32%) is a softer base than Q2 2025. A continued -30% would still show no stabilisation in the first quarter under new owners, and the market has no estimate to tell it so.

findings.finding: US nonstore retail sales rose 8.2% year on year in September 2026 (Census advance, via a secondary report). Online demand was healthy in the quarter, while QVC has been losing units against it.
findings.why_not_priced: Macro context, public and broadly priced. It is filed only as a proxy.
findings.independence: This is a proxy. Neither the company nor a direct counterparty has confirmed any transmission to QVC.

findings.finding: The chief growth officer, who oversaw US social and streaming (Alex Wellen), and the HSN brand / US merchandising president (Stacy Bowe) stepped down effective 2026-09-04, inside Q3. The interim CEO runs the company while the CEO search continues.
findings.why_not_priced: Public since August and largely priced. The audio review could show whether social/streaming growth held up without its owner, which is the only residual.

outside_window.finding: Former preferred holders' appeal of the confirmation order is pending in the District Court; the stay was denied. No ruling date is known.

baseline_tension: There is no skew or options market to agree with. The findings lean slightly long against a -11.8% 20-day run-up and a -58% drawdown from listing. The 5-day +8.6% bounce shows some buying already happened, which keeps p_up near 50.
lessons_applied: Rule 3 (own caveat reaches the number): the GoldenTree buy is cut from +0.8 to +0.4, because the seller of the same block was an equally informed, board-represented holder and GoldenTree stopped buying at $12.

Rule 5 (an unexplained drawdown is worth 0; documents beat inference) and the 'cheap is not a finding' rule: the EV-below-plan-range / liquidity finding is cut from +0.3 to +0.1. Only the Sep 30 liquidity disclosure stays as a two-sided item.
Rule 6 (inside what is already known): the negative-trend finding is cut from -0.5 to -0.3, because the H1 trend is public and the stock is already down 58%.
Rule 6 (bar unsourced): every finding is kept at or below 0.5 in absolute size.
Not from the file: the leadership-departure finding (-0.1) was added on re-reading the set. It is the one item absent from the draft.
Scaled measurement: p_up moves from 53 to 52 on the same caveats. abs_move_pct is unchanged at 10, because rule 8 (thin coverage) does not apply: there is no confirmed, unpriced, decisive number.
